# The fuchsia.git directories scripts/regen.py copies to vendor/fuchsia/<path>/ (design
# R6, D9), one per line: "<upstream path> <how its BUILD.bazel is made>".
#   upstream  upstream's BUILD.bazel, labels rewritten by regen.py
#   overlay   overlays/<path>/BUILD.bazel, hand-written and reviewed
#   idk       a FIDL library (milestone M8): only upstream's BUILD.bazel is copied, labels
#             rewritten; its .fidl sources are the IDK's (D7)
# Every crate a listed BUILD file depends on must be listed too. Keep sorted.
# FIDL libraries: pilot 1's closure (docs/closure/pilot1.json), each "idk" except
# fuchsia.sys2, which is not in the IDK: its .fidl files are copied from fuchsia.git at
# the revision ("upstream") and compiled by the IDK's fidlc like the others (M8).
# FIDL runtime crates: those of the rust flavor (fidl, rust_constants, fuchsia-async(-macro),
# fuchsia-sync; M8a) and of rust_next (fidl_next*, fuchsia-loom; M8b).
# Besides Rust crates, the list holds the Go sources of fidlgen_rust (milestone M7), which
# the overlay builds with rules_go: its binary, its codegen package and tools/fidl/lib/fidlgen;
# and the configs the prebuilt fidlgen_rust_next is run with.

sdk/fidl/fuchsia.component idk
